olders.part: "Each loop is an intent" — the names Understand, Shape, Execute, Change, Learn are no longer working names: the loops are named Discovery (was Understand), Slice (was Shape), Execute, Ship (was Change) and Learn; and §5 "Learn": its plays are /learn, /promote and /drift (in place of /next, /focus, /learn). Also the word ADR 029 took from it ("loop recipe" becomes drive) comes back: a loop is a loop.

§1 "A drive is a run of plays" — the word: a drive is now a loop, and the American-football origin of the name goes; §6 "The first drive: Kickoff" — Kickoff is now the Discovery loop; and §1's rule "A drive never shares a name with a play" — the Learn loop shares its name with the /learn play; the always-full-name rule ("the Learn loop", never a bare "loop") now separates them. Everything else in ADR 029 stands, under the new word.
§1 "The Shared Drive Run owns the steps between plays" — the name only: the Shared Drive Run is now the Shared Loop Run. What it owns does not change.
